articles.title: DNA Time Stamps Unlock the Strawberry's Secret Family Tree
articles.summary: Strawberries have a super complicated DNA puzzle—eight sets of chromosomes from different ancestors, some maybe extinct. Scientists used 'DNA time stamps' to finally piece together when and how those ancestors merged millions of years ago.

articles.title: A New AI Brain That Reads 12x Faster—But Is It for Real?
articles.summary: A startup called Subquadratic says its new AI model, SubQ, can handle 12 times more text at once than top chatbots, using way less energy. Independent tests back up some claims, but many experts still want to try it themselves.

articles.title: Could a Giant, Spiky Fruit Help Fix Your Gums?
articles.summary: Scientists in Brazil mixed jackfruit latex, pomegranate peel, and a medicine into a sticky gel that might reverse gum disease damage. In lab tests, it helped stem cells turn into bone-building cells.
